description: Get the release-order watch guide for an anime franchise: every season, film and special in the order they came out, where a new viewer can start, and how much filler each part has when that is known. This is release order, not story chronology. Give a title or a catalog ID.

mal_id.description: The catalog ID from a title search (the same number MyAnimeList uses). Use it instead of a title when you have it.

title.description: The show's name, in English or romaji, for example "Attack on Titan".

name: get_watch_order
